clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers gather at Stonefire Tavern in Ironforge’s Commons, just north of the city gates. The inn offers a hearth, dwarven ale, and a place to rest for those arriving from across Khaz Modan.

Stonefire Tavern welcomes travelers in Ironforge’s Commons, just north of the fortress gates. Innkeeper Firebrew runs the inn with his daughter Gwenna. Weary wayfarers can find meals, local brews, and lodging beneath the mountain. Travelers come in from across the Alliance to rest from Dun Morogh’s mountain snows, trade tales, or gather supplies before exploring the city. Its hearth draws them together at the heart of the Commons.
